# vergeio_member (Resource)

Add users or objects to groups in VergeIO. This resource manages group membership by associating a member (user or object) with a group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get the Administrators group
data "vergeio_groups" "all" {
  filter_name = "Administrators (default)"
}

# Create a user
resource "vergeio_user" "testuser" {
  name            = "testuser1"
  displayname     = "Test User 1"
  email           = "testuser@verge.io"
  enabled         = true
  type            = "normal"
  password        = "changeme123"
  change_password = true
}

# Add user to group
resource "vergeio_member" "membership" {
  group  = data.vergeio_groups.all.groups[0].id
  member = format("users/%s", vergeio_user.testuser.id)
}
```

Add a VM to a group:
```terraform
resource "vergeio_member" "vm_membership" {
  group  = 5
  member = "vms/123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group` (Number) - Key (ID) of the group to add the member to
- `member` (String) - Object to add in format `object_type/object_id` (e.g., `users/123`, `vms/456`)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) - Member ID in VergeIO

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID:

```shell
terraform import vergeio_member.example <member_id>
```
